snippet.title: "Turn Around, It's a Trap!" — Homeless Girl Saved 28 Bikers, What They Did Next Left Her in Tears
snippet.description:
She had no phone, no address and no ID. All she had was a notebook full of license plates—and the nerve to stand in front of 28 motorcycles.

Josie Avery aged out of foster care with a garbage bag and a bus ticket. For fourteen months she has lived in a trailer under the Old Ferry Bridge. One Sunday morning she runs out of the pines and stands in the middle of the road as a whole motorcycle club rides down the hill to honor Eli, killed in a hit-and-run eight months ago. "Stop! Turn around—it's a trap!" The curve is greased with oil, the railing has no bolts, a man with a rifle waits across the river, and someone sits in a boat under the bridge so nobody makes it out of the water.

The club's leader, Pop, is the only witness at tomorrow's trial. The bikers catch the road crew red-handed. Then a county deputy rolls down the hill, calls the bikers an armed gang, and looks the homeless girl up and down: no address, no ID, oil on her shoes. He opens the back door of his patrol car. She rides with him and they all go home—or everybody goes to jail, and Pop misses court.

👉 Watch till the end — the girl nobody ever bothered to ask is about to show a whole town what she wrote down.

If you love stories where the person everyone overlooks turns out to be the only one who was paying attention, subscribe for a new story every week.

This is a fictional story made for entertainment. All characters, places and events are invented.

#BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story

snippet.title: Kany García - Confieso (En Vivo Desde RD)
snippet.description:
Kany García - Confieso (En Vivo Desde RD)

CONFIESO
BY KANY GARCÍA

Allí mire tu foto en la nevera
De aquel viaje que hicimos en noviembre
Sonrió al descubrir tus mil maneras
Para quererme
Hoy como cada tarde
Te imaginaba

Confieso
Que me haces tanta falta
Para decirme todo va estar bien
Para escucharme con una guitarra
Sentado con tu taza cafe
Llore porque tu voz no está la casa
Rei porque me amaste con todo tu ser
Es una mezcla que me agarra el alma
Y rompe cada esquina de mi ser
Y como no, si eras mi todo
Y como no,…

La nochebuena se vuelve más fría
Y en abril se caen todas las flores
Y siento que me hablas cada día
En mil canciones
Hoy como cada tarde
Te imaginaba

Confieso…

Sigue a Kany García

yuri is one of the two tritagonists (alongside natsuki), as well as the secondary antagonist of the visual novel doki doki literature club!, one of the five members of the literature club, later replacing sayori as the vice-president in act 2 after she was deleted by monika in act 1.yuri joined the literature club out of her interest in fantasy and psychological horror novels. as of act 2, she became the game's secondary antagonist, although she is not really a villain, just a victim. yuri and natsuki are always playing together and sometimes yuri can abuse natsuki on some occasions. however, yuri thinks that natsuki is perfect and that she's a good friend. doki doki literature club! (ddlc) is a 2017 freeware visual novel developed by american independent game studio team salvato for linux, macos, and windows. the game was initially distributed through itch.io, and later became available on steam. the story is told from the perspective of a high school student who reluctantly joins the school's literature club on the insistence of his childhood best friend, and is given the option to romantically pursue three of its four female members. doki doki literature club! features a non-traditional plot structure with multiple endings and unlockable cutscenes with each of the main characters. although the game initially appears to be a lighthearted dating simulator, it is in fact a metafictional psychological horror game that extensively breaks the fourth wall.

mikan tsumiki is a character featured in danganronpa 2: goodbye despair. she has the title of ultimate nurse (super high school level health committee member). after catching despair disease in chapter 3 and regaining her memory, she set up a plan to murder ibuki mioda, who also contracted despair disease, but ended up murdering both ibuki and hiyoko saionji after the latter witnessed her attempt to murder ibuki. she had murdered for “the sake of her beloved”. but in reality, mikan, including ibuki and hiyoko, are still alive. danganronpa 2: goodbye despair is a 2012 visual novel developed by spike chunsoft. it is the second game in the danganronpa franchise following danganronpa: trigger happy havoc (2010). it was first released in japan for playstation portable in july 2012, and a port for playstation vita was released in japan in october 2013.development of the game started as kazutaka kodaka was writing the light novel prequel danganronpa zero and added hints about a sequel to the novel following their approval. kodaka aimed to develop a unique plot to give players more mysterious elements in a group of islands, inspired by the television series lost. the protagonist hajime hinata is part of a group of high-school students who are trapped on a tropical island by their high school's headmaster monokuma, a sentient stuffed bear, along with monomi, a sentient stuffed rabbit. similar to the first game, to leave the island, students must kill one of their peers and not be caught in the subsequent investigation and trial.

snippet.title: “Special Forces” Are Dropped on a New Alien Planet to Hunt Unknown Species!
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Species: Unknown full gameplay! We take a look at the brand new Map called HGC Stormrock!

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT SPECIES: UNKNOWN
Form a squad of up to 4 players to take on different contracts with escalating difficulty. Each mission plays differently depending on your objective, your teammates, the map and which of the 5 intelligent threats is stalking you. No one survives alone, but you can try. 
Every contract drops you into a different nightmare. Whether you're tasked with extracting a black box, capturing or eliminating an unknown threat, or even destroying the ship to prevent the creature from escaping… Each mission demands a specific strategy and none of them are easy.
The specimen is chosen procedurally from a growing roster of terrifying monsters. Each one comes with distinct behaviors, hunting patterns, strengths, and weaknesses. You’ll need to investigate your surroundings to gather vital clues and identify the threat in order to proceed smoothly (or not). Do your job and get rewarded, or die without anyone knowing.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747330/Species_Unknown/

snippet.title: Exasperation | FULL SHOWCASE (100% done)
snippet.description:
— I recommend reading the FAQ below —

Finally here after the long wait. Never could've foresaw what this would become when I uploaded the layout nearly a decade ago in 2017. This level has impacted my life quite a bit, for better or worse. I'm happy how it has turned out. This would not have been possible without GDNacho, Akunakun, and Sycro, who were the main driving forces behind the level, not to mention all the decorators of course. Hope you find it interesting.

— Timestamps —

0:00 Intro
0:21 @icerod
0:31 @kacurroo
0:40 @ElsunyX_OFICIAL
0:53 @arcliqht
1:00 @whyfour4
1:11 @ElsunyX_OFICIAL + @M3dinaGX_66
1:27 @Xcmines + @imSycro
1:39 @Chuckgamer1_
1:52 @어째서이런일이 + @MinigunGD77
2:06 @TheFakeFlame + @eligabretgd
2:17 @pastel_pink
2:37 DraKarMin + @GDNashit
2:58 @ElsunyX_OFICIAL
3:06 @kestarkes1651
3:13 @gdskulll4875
3:27 @GDNashit
3:44 schizonek + @Gother_L
3:49 @deltaaimee
3:58 @whyfour4
4:08 @dukegd
4:15 @syleriluvv
4:20 @Skywalker2016GD
4:27 @juanchus0444
4:35 @iCrowlley
4:42 @imSycro
4:51 @imSycro 
5:27 Credits

Polishers: @whyfour4, @thedashingmoney3121, @joaa3806, @imSycro, @MinigunGD77, @intrizgd, @akunakun123, @pastel_pink, @Skewbie 

(more detailed credits in video)

— FAQ —

- Is it actually done now?
Unless something catastrophic happens, it's essentially done, yes. Technically some playtesting/bugfixing is still ongoing but we don't expect it to significantly change how the showcase would look. Whatever changes that are made will be minor.

- Why did it take so long?
I've spoken on this before if you've looked in the right places, but it was a combination of reasons amounting to development hell made worse by an overly optimistic percentage estimation. At the time the 95% preview came out, the level still needed to be polished, and afterwards multiple parts eventually needed to be replaced for a variety of reasons. Fatigue and burnout from hosts and decorators, as well as people being busy with other projects, was also a factor.

- Is this top 1?
Possibly. The gameplay has been reverted to its unnerfed state unlike the 95% preview, although whether or not it would still be considered top 1 with the current state of the game (and the future state of the game whenever it's verified) is for someone else to determine. It would always be nice and it certainly could be top 1 but it's not why the level was built. It is not planned to be buffed to be harder than the original layout, with the exception of the decoration already in place.

- I can't even see anything, hasn't this been made into a memory level?
That will be up to the verifiers to determine, but if you are able to learn the gameplay by heart I don't suspect it to be as difficult to memorize as it is in dedicated memory levels, although still naturally harder than the layout by some degree obviously.

- This should've been kept as a layout, why was this even decorated?
The original layout was never intended to be a final version, as is the same for every layout I have made, just gameplay that theoretically could be decorated. Exasperation ended up getting decorated, technically the second layout of mine to become a full level after Woh Broh. The layout has always properly been just Exasperation Layout, and now finally actual Exasperation exists.

- I saw a different decorated version somewhere, what about that?
This is the only officially sanctioned Exasperation project, and no other fits closer to my vision. Other versions should not be considered official. The layout is also not decorated and should not be considered the definitive version of the level.

- Who's verifying it? Is it open verification?
It is not an open verification. We have chosen a selection of players who may attempt simultaneously. Subject to change, but potential verifiers at this time include: @agonom @HoverGD, @NickwoYT, @seregiusz, @spookkd
(2026/10/31)

- I hate the song, why didn't you change it?
The song is iconic and interesting, I would define it as an avant-garde progressive electronic sound collage. You may simply need to expand your music taste.

— Other Info —

Today we're taking on City Bridge Jumps in BeamNG.drive, attempting some absolutely CRAZY bridge jumps with massive crashes, insane speeds, and ridiculous car physics! Can these vehicles actually survive the jumps, or will they end up completely DESTROYED? We're pushing cars to their limits on the City Bridge Jumps BeamNG map, launching vehicles across huge gaps, attempting wild landings, and experiencing the realistic soft-body destruction that makes BeamNG.drive so satisfying! snippet.title: Help Us LYON, You're NA's Only Hope | The Dive Driven by Kia
snippet.description:
NA MADE IT TO QUARTERFINALS! Okay, we can all take a deep sigh of relief together. Azael, Kobe, and Meteos look back on Worlds Swiss Stage together, speculate on the matches, and reflect on just how important it is to play confidently and without fear despite how fast the tides can turn. Our hosts remind us to remember the pressure is higher on the Worlds stage, so your teams still need your support!

Our hosts look ahead to the Quarterfinals matchups, and let’s just say there are some rematches, high stakes games, and some chances for redemption. With Finals just around the corner, you better join the rest of the world in seeing which team will survive to achieve their dreams of lifting the Summoner’s Cup.

Worlds Quarterfinals tickets are still available for Allen, Texas! Catch the action in person by getting your tickets here: https://www.ticketmaster.com/league-of-legends-world-championships-tickets/artist/1906735
